entries.ff01f40301f1c4d3: Headquartered in Tama City, Tokyo, the company manufactures and sells measurement and testing equipment, including balancing machines and electric servomotor-type testing machines, based on vibration measurement technology. The company, its 6 subsidiaries and 1 other related company form the group. As of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 296. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. Revenue from external customers by product was ¥9,699 million for balancing machines, ¥2,526 million for electric servomotor-type testing machines, ¥950 million for materials testing machines, ¥444 million for shaft distortion automatic straightening machines and ¥1,327 million for others.
